method: Static review of GitHub repository metadata, README/docs, selected SKILL.md and code paths. Scores measure documented capability and evidence, not proof of output quality. No candidate install script or scanner was executed; no candidate output was independently reproduced.
scale: 0 = no evidence; 1 = minimal; 2 = partial; 3 = explicit guidance; 4 = detailed and task-specific; 5 = detailed with repeatable verification evidence. Browser scores measure provided verification capability, not a run performed by VibeSoft.

repositories.evidence: SKILL.md prescribes an audit, a product-derived visual direction, and ordered passes for spacing, color, icons, copy, type, layout, visuals, and motion; README documents screenshots and before/after examples.
repositories.limits: CC-BY-4.0 attribution required. Optional snapshot/story scripts need Playwright/Chromium and ffmpeg; image generation may use paid external services. Accessibility and responsive checks are less rigorous than visual direction.

repositories.evidence: README distinguishes new-work, 24 focused commands, scored critique, technical audit, and 62 deterministic slop rules. SKILL.md requires inspecting rendered output and project context; scripts include screenshots/live-browser support.
repositories.limits: Apache-2.0. Installer/CLI can write PRODUCT.md, DESIGN.md, plugins/hooks, or download platform binary. README documents a live Apply fallback using Codex/Claude permission and sandbox bypass flags. Do not use that path without explicit review. Detector rules are signals, not design judgment.

repositories.evidence: SKILL.md targets new-page art direction with a bounded flow and style picks; repository has slop lint, capture tooling, fixtures, and tests for visual rules. Code review of install.mjs found it removes the old destination before copying; hook source writes Claude settings at user or project scope and advises without blocking.
repositories.limits: MIT. Node and the pup/browser dependencies need review. `--remove` deletes known installed copies; `--force` bypasses preflight warnings. New-page lead by default; defer existing designs unless the user asks.

repositories.evidence: SKILL.md provides product-type-specific art direction, reusable design consistency/performance gates, and browser finish checks; repository contains checker scripts and visual effect assets. Code inspection found install.sh symlinks into agent skill folders and gate.mjs can install a stop hook, create project state, and use local browser automation.
repositories.limits: MIT. install.sh may remove a conflicting existing non-link destination to create its link. Node 22+/Chromium and hook scope require review; broad triggers and strong style prescriptions can override a project system unless routed carefully.

repositories.evidence: MIT SKILL.md offers a broad anti-cliché matrix, typography/layout axioms, visual DNA extraction, and responsive/mobile guidance.
repositories.limits: Five stars and one fork in snapshot; many absolute mandates lack evidence or measured validation. Tree also contains an unexplained zzprobe-in-working-repo skill. Defer pending provenance and full-content review.

repositories.evidence: MIT README and landing-page SKILL.md give intake, audience/offer, section structure, conversion copy, SEO, and a detailed visual system; includes a separate Figma skill and validator script.
repositories.limits: Landing-page and conversion focused; visual rules may be overly prescriptive for product interfaces. No browser verification found in selected skill. Script was inspected as a path but not run.

repositories.evidence: MIT collection has narrow skills for animation, performance, gestures, review, animation removal, and learning rules from user corrections; learn-taste explicitly writes rules without changing code.
repositories.limits: Collection is heterogeneous rather than one full designer workflow. Selected learn-taste skill is not an implementation or browser QA skill. Choose a single relevant entry.

repositories.evidence: MIT collection separates better-typography, colors, layout, motion, accessibility, interface-review, and build-design. Better-ui explicitly treats surface/icon details as polish after interaction is sound.
repositories.limits: Focused skills intentionally omit a unified new-product art-direction process. Do not install all entries simultaneously; select one by issue.

repositories.evidence: MIT SKILL.md describes searchable style, palette, font, UX, icon, chart, and stack data with a required design-system step. Repository includes data search, token scripts, stack guidance, and test files.
repositories.limits: Large CLI/data package and many overlapping skills; scripts/dependencies require code and installer review. Searchable recipes can encourage template matching without product-specific critique.

repositories.evidence: frontend-design SKILL.md directs product-grounded aesthetic decisions and a plan/review/build/critique process. A separate webapp-testing skill exists. Per-skill license files are present.
repositories.limits: GitHub API reports no root license; frontend-design references its own LICENSE.txt. The selected skill itself does not provide runnable browser capture or systematic responsive evidence.

repositories.evidence: SKILL.md defines a never-ship-first-version loop, design rules, anti-pattern detection, and implementation workflow; preflight script has clean/dirty fixtures and tests; upstream drift script indicates provenance monitoring.
repositories.limits: 104 stars/12 forks at review. Composite MIT AND Apache-2.0 license files and upstream-derived content require per-source/attribution review before redistribution; drift test alone does not validate visual outcomes.

repositories.evidence: Apache-2.0 npm CLI and SKILL.md document navigation, interaction, snapshots, resizing, screenshots, and browser sessions; it provides observation/action primitives, not aesthetic rules. Repository maintenance update.js uses execSync and removes/replaces its generated skill destination.
repositories.limits: Tool only; 0 in design dimensions means not its purpose, not poor implementation. Requires Node/npm package installation and browser runtime. Only use browser sessions and URLs authorized for testing.

repositories.evidence: README documents a router, one lead plus at most two supporting skills, explicit conflict rules, upstream plugin sync, and differentiated roles. It includes frontend-stack and design-critique SKILL.md paths.
repositories.limits: Not a standalone design skill and not verified Codex install format. GitHub reports NOASSERTION for root license; aggregated plugin licenses vary and optional plugins can invoke paid services. Do not mirror wholesale.

repositories.evidence: CC0 README organizes skills, design context, MCP servers, and browser 'eyes', with a useful anti-pattern checklist and routing references. Tree contains no SKILL.md.
repositories.limits: Three stars/two forks and older push in snapshot. Useful for discovery; not an installable skill and claims are not an independent evaluation.
